meta.source: ws.json run term-ws (the PTY-owned parts of the recorded frames)

description: The recorded WS frames that pin what the terminal manager owns: exit codes (normal preserved, signal deaths 0), the exited-record replay on late attach, the missing-binary scrollback, and the child env contract as the envdump child printed it.

steps.description: B types "exit 3": bye 3, then {type:"exit", code:3}, then close 1000 after 200 ms.
C attaches to the exited, lingering record: hello(state exited, exitCode 3) + full scrollback + exit + close 1000.
Late attach: scrollback "execvp(3) failed.: No such file or directory", exit code 1.
steps.replay: execvp(3) failed.: No such file or directory

steps.description: Late attach: scrollback with argv, cwd, size, the sorted child env + exit + close. Pins process.env pass-through, RIVETOS_USER_ID stripped, PATH via withUserLocalBin, roster then entry env, RIVET_* vars, TERM, COLORTERM, locale.

steps.description: Child kills itself with SIGTERM. node-pty reports {exitCode:0, signal:15}; pty.ts forwards exitCode only → exit frame code 0.
Self SIGKILL: node-pty {exitCode:0, signal:9} → exit frame code 0.
DELETE /term: den sends SIGHUP; node-pty {exitCode:0, signal:1} → exit frame code 0, close 1000.
